Description

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain hands-on experience building software for our telehealth platform.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers on backend services, APIs, databases, and internal tools that support patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant-facing applications.

This internship is designed for students and early-career developers who have a foundation in programming and want to learn how professional engineering teams design, build, test, and maintain production software.

Our engineering stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, SST, and SQL databases, with technologies such as Prisma, Drizzle, and tRPC used across the platform.

You'll receive guidance through code reviews and technical discussions while contributing to well-defined projects with practical outcomes.

We don't expect you to know every technology in our stack before joining. We're looking for someone who is curious, enjoys writing code, asks thoughtful questions, and wants to improve through real engineering work.

You'll have opportunities to see how backend systems connect to the rest of our platform and develop a stronger understanding of software architecture, testing, security, and deployment.

-   Contribute to backend development projects under the guidance of experienced engineers.
-   Build and improve small APIs, backend services, and application features using TypeScript and Node.js.
-   Work with SQL databases to retrieve, update, and organize application data.
-   Assist with backend functionality supporting patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and merchant tools.
-   Help develop and maintain integrations between internal services and third-party APIs.
-   Learn how Bask uses AWS and SST to build and deploy serverless applications.
-   Assist with writing database queries, updating data models, and implementing application logic.
-   Write automated tests to verify backend functionality and help prevent regressions.
-   Investigate bugs, reproduce issues, and work with engineers to identify solutions.
-   Participate in code reviews and learn how to improve code quality, readability, and maintainability.
-   Collaborate with engineers to understand technical requirements and break work into manageable tasks.
-   Help maintain documentation for APIs, backend features, and development workflows.
-   Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to support coding, debugging, testing, and learning while reviewing generated code carefully.
-   Learn how authentication, authorization, and application security are implemented in production systems.
-   Assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting backend services.
-   Contribute to improving existing code, simplifying workflows, and reducing repetitive engineering tasks.
-   Work on clearly defined projects with measurable outcomes and feedback from an engineering mentor.
-   Learn how changes are tested, reviewed, deployed, and monitored in a production environment.
-   Participate in engineering discussions, ask questions, and share ideas.
-   Develop practical experience with Git, collaborative development, and professional software engineering practices.
-   Build confidence in independently completing smaller engineering tasks while learning from the team.

Requirements

-   Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or developing equivalent skills through self-study, bootcamps, or practical projects.
-   Basic programming experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another modern programming language.
-   Familiarity with programming fundamentals, data structures, and basic software design principles.
-   Experience building software through coursework, personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions.
-   Basic understanding of how web applications, APIs, and backend services work.
-   Familiarity with relational databases or introductory SQL concepts.
-   Basic experience with Git or another version control system.
-   Ability to write readable code and explain your approach to solving programming problems.
-   Willingness to learn backend development using TypeScript and Node.js.
-   Interest in cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, and production software development.
-   Ability to debug basic programming issues and seek guidance when needed.
-   Willingness to learn automated testing and software quality practices.
-   Interest in using AI-assisted development tools while understanding and validating the code they produce.
-   Strong curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.
-   Ability to communicate clearly, ask questions, and incorporate feedback.

About Base

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.

About the Role

We're looking for a Design Intern to join our Creative team this spring/next summer and work across some of Base's fastest-moving channels: paid ads, brand campaigns, and the visual systems that hold it all together. You'll work alongside our designers and marketing team to produce creative that stops people mid-scroll, build scalable template systems in Figma, and help us learn what resonates with homeowners across the country.

This isn't a "shadow someone and take notes" internship. You'll own real output from week one — designing work that ships to the market, building tools your teammates actually use, and shaping how Base shows up wherever people see us. If you're excited about the intersection of brand, performance, and craft, this is the role.

What You'll Do

- Design creative on a weekly cadence across paid, brand, and campaign work, working within Base's brand system while pushing the work forward visually.

- Build and maintain reusable Figma template systems that both the design and marketing teams can use to quickly spin up new variations without starting from scratch.

- Conduct competitive research — studying what other brands (in energy, DTC, home services, and beyond) are running across channels — and bring back ideas worth testing.

- Organize and build a library of our top-performing creative so the marketing team has a go-to resource for proven templates and formats.

- Collaborate with designers and marketers to iterate on concepts based on performance data and creative instinct.

What You'll Bring

- Strong visual design fundamentals — typography, color, layout, hierarchy — with a portfolio that shows range and taste.

- Working proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and an understanding of how to build templates others can use without breaking.

- Genuine curiosity about what makes design work — you pay attention to the creative around you and have opinions about it.

- Ability to move quickly and manage your own time across multiple deliverables without losing quality.

- Comfort giving and receiving direct feedback — our team iterates fast and ego slows things down.

About the Team

The Creative team owns how Base looks, sounds, and feels. Brand campaigns, paid ads, photography, illustration, all of it. We’re five people who like each other a lot and take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The work is real — we’re building a consumer brand in an industry that’s never had one — and it ships fast. You’ll learn a ton, make things people actually see, and have FUN. Come build with us.

Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.

Our Values

- First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

- Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

- Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

- Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

- Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

- Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

- Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

Do the best work of your life at Base.

NEW GRADUATE ENGINEER, MECHANICAL

Some engineering groups design, build, activate, modify, and maintain the fluid and mechanical systems that power, restrain, and measure the most powerful high-volume rocket engines in the world, while others specialize in the design and execution of unique tests for engines, components, and spacecraft on an accelerated schedule. TEST OPERATIONS:

- Develop and execute tests at the engine and component level to evaluate hardware performance and survivability during the mission

- Develop and maintain test procedures, sequences, scripts, configuration files, and software

- Operate and troubleshoot data acquisition and control systems, wiring, and instrumentation (DAQ systems are primarily National Instruments-based)

- Automate repetitive test operations to increase efficiency and safety

- Analyze, design, and build systems that support testing of fully integrated flight vehicles, individual rocket engines, and various rocket components

- Work directly with skilled technicians to build your designs and fix real-world problems on the fly

- Maintain a tight feedback loop with the test operations team to rapidly alter plans as necessary to meet tight testing deadlines critical to company success

- Operate and troubleshoot equipment to achieve testing objectives, and apply lessons learned to iterate system designs for improved performance and maintenance

- Evaluate complex engineering needs and arrive at solutions to seemingly impractical problems that support test programs and achieve company objectives

- Take a hands-on approach to tackling rapidly emerging field projects that keep the company testing rocket engines and vehicles every single day

- Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or physics

- 1+ years of mechanical and/or fluids engineering experience via project team, research, internships, and/or professional experience

- Critical thinking and problem solving in stressful, dynamic situations

- Positive responses and outcomes to challenges posed by short deadlines

- Creativity to imagine and design for reliability, efficiency, and maintainability from scratch

- Driven approach to addressing challenges and opportunities—an enthusiastic, self-motivated, positive, can-do attitude

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
